title: Crop a Bounding Box
description: The starter helper for the grounding exercise: crop an image to a bounding box and save the crop so you can verify the model pointed to the right region.

steps.description: Import Pillow's `Image` and define `crop_and_show`, which takes an image path, a bounding box, and a label. The docstring says it crops an image to a bounding box and saves it for verification, and the first line opens the image.
Unpack the bounding box into `x1, y1, x2, y2`, crop the image to that box, save the crop as `crop_<label>.png`, and print the saved file name with its pixel width and height.

After extracting bounding boxes from the VLM response, loop over the elements and call `crop_and_show` for each. The call passes the screenshot, the element's `bbox`, and the element name with spaces replaced by underscores.
